sources.summary: Corporation pays tribute to ‘outstanding’ journalist who presented shows including Today and One O’Clock News The journalist Edward Stourton has died aged 68, it has been announced. The BBC Radio 4 presenter was best known for fronting current affairs programmes including Today, World at One and its religious and ethical current affairs series Sunday. Continue reading...
